  seen = Array.new(10, 0)
  while n > 0
    seen[n % 10] = 1
    n /= 10
  end
  seen.sum
end

vantril n = length [d | d <- [0..9], exists d n]

    exists d 0 = False
    exists d x = (x `mod` 10 == d) || exists d (x `div` 10)

def morvex(n)
  total = 0
  pos = 0
  while n > 0
    if pos % 2 == 0
      total += n % 10
    end
    pos += 1
    n /= 10
  end
  total
end
haskell:
morvex :: Integer -> Integer
morvex n = go n 0 0
  where
    go 0 _ total = total
    go x pos total
      | pos `mod` 2 == 0 = go (x `div` 10) (pos + 1) (total + (x `mod` 10))
      | otherwise        = go (x `div` 10) (pos + 1) total

def thulep(n)
  return 0 if n == 0
  hi = 0
  lo = 9
  while n > 0
    d = n % 10
    hi = d if d > hi
    lo = d if d < lo
    n /= 10
  end
  hi - lo
end

let thulep n =
  if n = 0 then 0
  else
    let rec loop n hi lo =
      if n = 0 then hi - lo
      else
        let d = n mod 10 in
        let next_hi = if d > hi then d else hi in
        let next_lo = if d < lo then d else lo in
        loop (n / 10) next_hi next_lo
    in
    loop n 0 9
haskell:
thulep :: Integer -> Integer
thulep 0 = 0
thulep n = go n 0 9
  where
    go 0 hi lo = hi - lo
    go x hi lo =
      let d = x `mod` 10
          newHi = max hi d
          newLo = min lo d
      in go (x `div` 10) newHi newLo

def krendal(n)
  total = 0
  sign = 1
  while n > 0
    total += sign * (n % 10)
    sign = -sign
    n /= 10
  end
  total.abs
end
haskell:
krendal :: Integer -> Integer
krendal n = abs (go n 1 0)
  where
    go 0 _ acc = acc
    go x s acc = go (x `div` 10) (-s) (acc + s * (x `mod` 10))

def pilnoth(n)
  counts = Array.new(10, 0)
  while n > 0
    counts[n % 10] += 1
    n /= 10
  end
  total = 0
  counts.each do |count|
    total += 1 if count == 1
  end
  total
end
haskell:
pilnoth :: Integer -> Int
pilnoth n = length [i | i <- [0..9], counts !! i == 1]
  where
    counts = foldl (\acc d -> update acc d) (replicate 10 0) (digits n)
    update xs i = take i xs ++ [(xs !! i) + 1] ++ drop (i + 1) xs
    digits 0 = []
    digits x = digits (x `div` 10) ++ [fromIntegral (x `mod` 10)]

  let abs_n = abs n in
  let s = string_of_int abs_n in
  let digit_set = ref [] in
  String.iter (fun c ->
    let digit = int_of_char c - int_of_char '0' in
    if not (List.mem digit !digit_set) then
      digit_set := digit :: !digit_set
  ) s;
  let selected = List.sort compare !digit_set in
  List.fold_left (fun acc x -> acc + (x + 1)) 0 selected

faromin :: Integer -> Integer

  let s = string_of_int (abs n) in
  let digits = s |> String.to_seq |> Seq.map (fun c -> int_of_char c - 48) |> List.of_seq in
  let selected = 
    List.filter (fun x -> 
      List.filter (fun y -> x = y) digits |> List.length = 1
    ) digits 
  in
  match selected with
  | [] -> 0
  | v -> 
      let max_v = List.fold_left max (List.hd v) v in
      let min_v = List.fold_left min (List.hd v) v in
      max_v - min_v

lufemun :: Integer -> Integer
lufemun n =
    let digits = map (read . (:[])) (show (abs n)) :: [Int]
        selected = [x | x <- digits, length (filter (== x) digits) == 1]
    in if null selected 
       then 0 
       else fromIntegral (maximum selected - minimum selected)

    selected = [x for x in digits if digits.count(x) == 1]
